title: 第十章 大棒与枣
slug: 电锯人开局契约斩杀线恶魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“对、对不起！我不是故意的……我实在是撑不住了……求求您别杀我……”

“我只是一时没站稳，不是……”

小红顾不上身上摔出的红痕，蜷缩在地板上，看上去狼狈至极。

然而，想象中的打骂或是更过分的惩罚并没有落下来，言良看着她，似乎是在思考接下来要怎么处理东山小红。

房间里安静了几秒。

“东山小红……你很累吗？”

言良平淡的声音自头顶上方落下，没有什么生气的意思，倒是带着一丝出人意料的平静。

小红愣了一下，脸上流露出错愕的神色。她小心翼翼地昂起脑袋，迎上言良那只纯白色的眼眸，下意识地抽噎着点了点头：

“嗯……很累……很痛苦……”

“一码归一码，你的确是差点害死了我。但我不仅不计前嫌，还将你从赌局之中拯救了出来。”言良俯下身，“你现在就算再怎么累，再怎么苦，总比在赌局里被人夺走身体然后死亡要好些吧？”

小红浑身一颤，脑海中再次闪过无头尸体喷血的骇人画面。相比之下，自己现在虽然失去了所有的尊严，像条小狗一样趴在地上，但她还活着。

“是……比死要好……”东山小红小声地呢喃着，像是在回答言良，又像是在拼命说服自己。

看着她这副已经被打碎了心理防线的模样，言良知道，火候已经到了。

对于调教宠……调教下属来说，没有什么比大棒与甜枣更为管用的了。

言良之所以把她逼到这种难堪的境地，就是要摸清她的底线，再想办法让她老老实实听自己话做事。

这女人在赌桌上可是一点都没犹豫地把自己给卖了，作为苦主让她替自己卖命完全是合情合理的要求。当然，这作为一场交易，他也自有相应的筹码。

“东山小红，你是个胆小鬼，为了活命你可以出卖任何人。而刚才在大楼里面，当你看到公安的人出现时，你以为你得救了对吧？”言良轻笑了一声，“但是你觉得，那个叫玛奇玛的女人，真的在乎你的死活吗？”

听到这句话，东山小红忽然愣住了。

"Yes, I'm sorry! I didn't mean it... I really can't hold it anymore... Please don't kill me..."

"I just couldn't stand firm for a moment, it's not..."

Xiaohong ignored the red marks on her body and curled up on the floor, looking extremely embarrassed.

However, the imaginary beating or more excessive punishment did not happen. Yan Liang looked at her, seeming to be thinking about how to deal with Dongshan Xiaohong next.

The room was quiet for a few seconds.

"Dongshan Xiaohong...are you tired?"

Yan Liang's calm voice fell from above his head. There was no hint of anger, but there was a hint of unexpected calmness.

Xiaohong was stunned for a moment, with a look of astonishment on her face.She raised her head carefully, met Yan Liang's pure white eyes, and nodded subconsciously with sobs:

"Well... very tired... very painful..."

"One code after another, you did almost kill me. But I not only ignored the past grudges, but also saved you from the gambling game." Yan Liang leaned down, "No matter how tired you are now, no matter how miserable you are, it is better than having your body taken away and then dying in the gambling game, right?"

Xiaohong shuddered, and the horrifying scene of a headless corpse spurting blood flashed through her mind again.In contrast, although she had lost all her dignity and was lying on the ground like a puppy, she was still alive.

"Yes... it's better than death..." Dongshan Xiaohong murmured quietly, as if she was answering Yan Liang, but also as if she was desperately trying to convince herself.

Seeing that her psychological defense had been shattered, Yan Liang knew that the heat had come.

There is nothing more effective than a big stick and sweet dates for training pets... and training subordinates.

The reason why Yanliang forced her into such an embarrassing situation was to find out her bottom line and then find a way to make her listen to him and do things honestly.

This woman sold herself out at the gambling table without any hesitation. As a mistress, it was a completely reasonable request for her to work for him.Of course, as this is a transaction, he also has corresponding bargaining chips.

"Dongshan Xiaohong, you are a coward. You will betray anyone to survive. And in the building just now, when you saw the police officers appearing, you thought you were saved, right?" Yan Liang chuckled, "But do you think that woman named Makima really cares about your life or death?"

Hearing these words, Dongshan Xiaohong was suddenly stunned.
